records.subject: SDC
records.title: World of Design and Construction
records.description: Exploration of architecture, interior design, landscape architecture, and construction management through equity, environment, and economy; careers in the built environment considered.

records.subject: SDC
records.title: New Student Seminar in the School of Design and Construction
records.description: For majors, minors, or those with an academic interest: an introduction to planning and completion of undergraduate study in SDC programs including Architectural Studies, Interior Design, Landscape Architecture, or Construction Management.

records.subject: SDC
records.title: Social Justice in the Built Environment
records.description: Historical context and current debates on urbanism including environmental racism, gentrification, redlining, postcolonialism, and public monuments.

records.subject: SDC
records.title: Foundational Drawing
records.description: Development of skills relating to drawing 2D and 3D objects, one and two point perspective as well as orthographic projection.

records.subject: SDC
records.title: Foundation Studio I
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: SDC 120 with a C or better.
records.description: Exploration and communication of theories and concepts related to basic 2-dimensional and 3-dimensional principles of built space.

records.subject: SDC
records.title: Design Through Literature
records.description: Explorations in using the methods and venues of art to translate literary themes into three-dimensional objects and spaces using non-digital media and techniques; requires no prior knowledge of art or design.

records.subject: SDC
records.title: Global History of Design I
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the major in Architectural Studies, Interior Design, or Landscape Architecture.
records.description: Global developments in design through the seventeenth century CE.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SDC
records.title: Fabrication Lab Practice
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the major in Architectural Studies, Interior Design, Landscape Architecture, or Construction Management.
records.description: Hands-on exploration of School of Design and Construction shop facilities. Students complete a small project while learning safe and efficient use of woodshop machines and hand tools.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SDC
records.title: Global History of Design II
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: SDC 250 with a C or better.
records.description: Global developments in design from the seventeenth century CE to the present day.

records.subject: SDC
records.title: Building Energy Codes, Standards, and Rating Systems
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to any major in the College of Engineering and Architecture; junior standing.
records.description: Navigation and application of the current Washington residential energy code; employment of rating systems that exceed code requirements. Credit not granted for both SDC 441 and SDC 541.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SDC
records.title: Integrated Study Tour
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the major in Architectural Studies, Interior Design, Landscape Architecture, or Construction Management.
records.description: Selected issues in the field of design and construction in connection with an organized field trip.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SDC
records.title: Energy Modeling I
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to any major in the College of Engineering and Architecture; junior standing.
records.description: Creation, analysis, and results interpretation of energy models for small scale housing typologies. Recommended preparation: Basic knowledge in 3D modeling software such as Sketchup or Revit. Credit not granted for both SDC 451 and SDC 551.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SDC
records.title: Energy Modeling II
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to any major in the College of Engineering and Architecture; junior standing.
records.description: Creation, analysis, and results interpretation for multi-zone mid-scale housing typologies. Recommended preparation: Basic knowledge in 3D modeling software such as Sketchup or Revit. Credit not granted for both SDC 452 and SDC 552.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SDC
records.title: Professional Practice
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the major in Architectural Studies, Construction Management, Interior Design, or Landscape Architecture.
records.description: Current professional practice issues related to the business and practice of design and construction.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SDC
records.title: Professional Practice Coop/Internship I
records.description: Practicum for students admitted to the VCEA Professional Practice and Experiential Learning Program; integration of coursework with on-the-job professional experience. (Crosslisted course offered as ENGR 488, BIO ENG 488, CHE 488, CE 488, CPT S 488, E E 488, ME 488, MSE 488, SDC 488.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SDC
records.title: Professional Practice Coop/Internship II
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite:  By department permission; sophomore standing.
records.description: Practicum for students admitted to the VCEA Professional Practice and Experiential Learning Program; continuation of ENGR 488. (Crosslisted course offered as ENGR 489, SDC 489.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SDC
records.title: Seminar in Design and Construction
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ARCH 203 with a C or better, I D 203 with a C or better, or LND ARCH 263 with a C or better; or graduate standing.
records.description: Interdisciplinary exploration of issues, projects, and research relevant to the field of design and construction.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SDC
records.title: Special Topics in Design and Construction
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ARCH 203 with a C or better, I D 203 with a C or better, or LND ARCH 263 with a C or better, or graduate standing.
records.description: Advanced study in topics related to the design and construction disciplines.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SDC
records.title: Special Problems
records.description: Independent study conducted under the jurisdiction of an approving faculty member; may include independent research studies in technical or specialized problems; selection and analysis of specified readings; development of a creative project; or field experiences.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.
